summary: Sach mo nguon ve AI Agent design va engineering practice, system mo ta memory, multi-agent, RAG, reinforcement-learning, la huan luyen ve AI Agent.
usecases: Thiet ke AI Agent tu dong hoa tac vu lap lai cho doanh nghiep.
Xay dang coding assistant co context awareness tac gia IDE.
ideas: AI nhan dang giup dat lịch, viet email va quan ly calendar su dung agent memory va tool calling.
He thong multi-agent phan tich thi truong tai chinh thuc te va thuc thi giao dich.
